answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable work history before it can trade: new identities start in a harbor with capped volume, and only after sustained useful work do they graduate. A prism of independent attestations, from peers, clients, and auditors checking the same record from different angles, makes one fake identity cheap but a thousand expensive, because each must separately pay stake, time, and compute. Newcomers cannot fake an oasis of reputation overnight; slashing the stake on proven fraud turns Sybil farming from free spam into a losing investment.
